runs.entry: Run at the operator's word ("re run all under v5", the names still carrying v4.1 bands), interactive dispatch under the canonical brief, three analysts in parallel (ASML, PLTR, SNPS), lock held by the main session; the brief's one departure is the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25. Price **$196.75** (2026-10-23, aggregator, flagged) x **2,403,058,480 shares** (Class A 2,300.7M, B 101.3M, F 1.0M; 10-Q cover `0001321655-26-000041`) = cap **$472.80B** ($508.20B diluted); sovereign **5.33%** (Treasury 30-year, 2026-10-23). Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE): the Government segment decides (56% of 2021 to 2025 segment contribution); the ten-year economics turn on U.S. defence budgets, FASA (the 10-K: a change or repeal "would adversely affect" its federal position), AIP against the model makers it routes, and software pricing as the models change. Revenue $742.6M (2019) to $4,475M (2025), Q2 2026 up 93%; U.S. government 41% to 44% of revenue every year; RPO $4.9B, many contracts terminable for convenience. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash (OCF less stock pay less capex) -$457.0M, -$381.1M, $221.2M, $449.6M, $1,416.6M (2021 to 2025), mean $249.8M ($133.8M less interest income, all-equity); the sign change leaves the no-growth case alone, range **$4.61 a share** (diluted, net cash added), fair price **$4.16 all-equity** ($0.97 equity-only); on trailing owner cash the price needs about 45% growth for ten years to earn the floor. Facts after the stop: options exercised worth $3.0B (2025) and $3.8B (2024) against $684M of stock-pay expense; share count up 32% since February 2021; CEO realised $547.5M on vesting against $8.6M in the proxy table; $118.4M of 2022 revenue (6.2%) from companies Palantir funded; a featured adjusted figure and guidance; the chief accounting officer resigned February 2025; founders hold up to 49.999999% of the vote; the 2022 class action dismissed, appeal argued March 2026. Competitors (owner cash on revenue, five years, own filings): PLTR 9.6%, SNOW -16.3%, DDOG 5.1%, AI -112%, BAH 5.5%. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; four pathspec commits plus a contamination-line commit, own paths only; 36 ids, no slip (the analyst's check). Contamination declared: `Screens/` file names; after the verdict, two parallel analysts' commit subjects; none used. Position note filled at the fold: not held. No alert (closed before Q7); the v4.1 bands PLTR-floor-band and PLTR-reread-band retired by this fold.
runs.narr: TOO HARD (NATURE) at Q1: a government-weighted AI platform whose ten-year economics turn on defence budgets, procurement law and the model makers. Computation only: range $4.61, fair $4.16 all-equity vs $196.75. The strongest facts after the stop are on pay: options exercised worth $3.0B in 2025 against $684M expensed, and the CEO's $547.5M realised against $8.6M in the proxy table.
